description: Append-only field-level edit row capturing each manager-driven payload mutation on a POSpire Offline Sync Review. Distinct from Activity (action-level audit) — Edit rows describe WHICH field changed and from-what to-what, so a side-by-side diff or compliance export can reconstruct the change history. Never edited or deleted post-create.

fields.description: The error_category at the time of the edit — useful for filtering edits by what they were trying to fix (e.g. 'show me every accounting_period_closed edit').
fields.label: Category

fields.description: JSON path of the field that changed, in dot+bracket notation (e.g. `posting_date`, `items[0].rate`). For top-level field edits this is just the field name.
fields.label: Field Path

fields.description: Value as it was before the edit, JSON-serialised. Truncated server-side to keep activity rows under the MariaDB row-size limit.
fields.label: Before

name: POSpire Offline Sync Review Edit
